title: घरेलु महिला हिंसाःशिवशंकरटोल, भी.न.पा.–१८ कन्चनपुरको अवस्था विश्लेषण {Domestic violence against women: Situation analysis of Shivshankartol, B.N.P.-18 Kanchanpur}
authors: वम Bam, निर्मला कुमारी Nirmala Kumari
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेख भी.न.पा.–१८, शिवशंकर टोल कन्चनपुरमा घरेलु महिला हिंसाको अवस्था शीर्षकमा केन्द्रित रहेको छ । घरेलु हिंसाको कारण पारिवारिक स्थिति, आर्थिक, सामाजिक, राजनैतिक, वैवाहिक स्थितिसँग सम्बन्धित समस्याहरू पुरूषको तुलनामा महिलाहरू नै भोग्न बाध्य हुनुपर्ने कारणहरू, यसका रूप एवम् परिणामहरूको बारे बोध गर्न‘ यस अध्ययनको मुख्य उद्देश्य रहेको छ । यसको अध्ययन विधिमा वर्णनात्मक एवं विश्लेषणात्मक अनुसन्धान ढाँचाको प्रयोग गरेको छ शिवशंकर टोलका २३६ घरधुरी मध्येबाट ५५ घरधुरीका महिलाहरूलाई उत्तरदाताको रूपमा संलग्न गरिएको अध्ययनमा महिलाहरूसँग प्रत्यक्ष वा अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा कुराकानी, अवलोकन, घरधुरी सर्वेक्षण आदि कार्यबाट महिलाहरूले भोग्नु परेको घरेलु हिंसाको बारेमा मुख्यतया तथ्यको नजिक पुग्ने अध्ययनमा संलग्न गरिएका ५५ जना महिलाहरूको पारिवारिक स्थिति, आर्थिक, सामाजिक, राजनैतिक, वैवाहिक स्थिति लगायत हिंसाबाट पिडित हुनुको मुख्य कारणहरू, यसकारूप एवम् परिणामहरू खोतल्नु रहेको छ । महिलाहरूले भोग्नु परेका घरेलु हिंसा र यससँग सम्बन्धित सामाजिक, आर्थिक,राजनैतिक, पारिवारिक, शैक्षिक लगायतका विषयवस्तुसँग प्रत्यक्ष अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा जोडिन आउने कुराहरूलाई उजागर गरी केही मात्रामा प्रस्फुटन गर्ने कोशिश गरिएको छ । नेपाली समाजमा गहिरो जरा गाडेको पितृसत्ता र लैङ्गिक भूमिकाका कारण महिलामाथि हुने हिंसा जहिले पनि व्याप्त छ । नेपालमा पितृसत्तामा केन्द्रित एउटा सामाजिक संरचना विद्यमान छ । महिलाहरूलाई कानुनी, आर्थिक वा सामाजिक निर्णय गर्ने कुनै स्वतन्त्रता दिइएको छैन, जसले गर्दा महिलाहरुको जीवन दिनानुदिन संकटग्रस्त हुन पुगेको छ ।
american_english:
This research article focuses on the situation of domestic violence against women in Shivshankar Tol, Kanchanpur B.N.P.-18. It aims to understand the causes of domestic violence, the problems related to family, economic, social, political, and marital situations that force women to suffer compared to men, and the forms and consequences of this suffering. The study uses both descriptive and analytical research methods. From 236 households in Shivshankar Tol, 55 women were selected as respondents. The research examines the family, economic, social, political, and marital situations of these women, as well as the main causes, forms, and consequences of their suffering from domestic violence, both directly and indirectly. The study reveals and attempts to explain how women's experiences of domestic violence connect with related social, economic, political, family, and educational issues. Due to Nepal's deeply entrenched patriarchy and gender roles, violence against women is widespread. Nepal has a patriarchal social structure where women have no independent authority in legal, economic, or social decision-making, making their lives increasingly precarious.

british_english:
The present research article is focused on the situation of domestic violence against women in Shivshankar Tol, Kanchanpur B.N.P.-18. The primary objective of this study is to comprehend the causes of domestic violence, the issues linked to familial, economic, societal, political, and matrimonial circumstances that necessitate women to endure hardships in comparison to males, as well as the manifestations and repercussions of such hardships. The methodology employed in this study incorporates both descriptive and analytical research frameworks. From a total of 236 households in Shivshankar Tol, 55 women were chosen as participants for the study. The investigation scrutinizes the familial, economic, societal, political, and matrimonial contexts of these women, alongside the primary catalysts, forms, and outcomes associated with their victimization by domestic violence, whether overt or covert. The study elucidates and endeavours to illustrate the interconnections between women's encounters with domestic violence and concomitant social, economic, political, familial, and educational matters. In Nepali society, deeply rooted patriarchy and gender roles perpetuate the prevalence of violence against women. Nepal operates within a patriarchal social structure where women lack autonomous decision-making authority in legal, economic, or societal domains, thereby rendering their lives increasingly vulnerable and unstable.
